extraction_argv:
import hashlib,json,pathlib,tarfile,sys
archive,sha,target=sys.argv[1:]
archive=pathlib.Path(archive); target=pathlib.Path(target)
raw=archive.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==sha
assert target.resolve()==target and not target.exists() and not target.is_symlink()
with tarfile.open(archive,"r:gz") as handle:
 members=handle.getmembers()
 assert len(members)==25 and len({m.name for m in members})==25
 for member in members:
  p=pathlib.PurePosixPath(member.name)
  assert member.isfile() and not p.is_absolute() and ".." not in p.parts and str(p)==member.name
 target.mkdir()
 component=target/"component"; component.mkdir()
 handle.extractall(component,filter="data")
assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha
print(json.dumps({"status":"qfo_parameter_archive_freshly_extracted","archive":{"path":str(archive),"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":sha},"directory":str(component),"members":25,"only_regular_canonical_members":True,"archive_unmodified_after_extraction":True,"publication_ready":False},indent=2))

import sys,os,runpy,json
driver,directory,sha,output,forbidden=sys.argv[1:]
forbidden=os.path.realpath(forbidden)
phase={"name":"canary"}
blocked=[]
observed={"file_events":0}
def guard(event,args):
 if event in {"open","os.listdir","os.scandir"} and args and isinstance(args[0],(str,bytes,os.PathLike)):
  observed["file_events"]+=1
  path=os.path.realpath(os.fsdecode(args[0]))
  if path==forbidden or path.startswith(forbidden+os.sep):
   blocked.append({"phase":phase["name"],"event":event,"path":path})
   raise PermissionError("Original checkout path forbidden by relocation probe")
sys.addaudithook(guard)
try:
 open(forbidden+"/LICENSE.md","rb")
 raise AssertionError("Canary unexpectedly permitted")
except PermissionError:
 pass
assert len(blocked)==1
phase["name"]="reproduction"
sys.argv=[driver,"reproduce","--directory",directory,"--manifest-sha256",sha,"--output",output]
runpy.run_path(driver,run_name="__main__")
modules=sorted(name for name in sys.modules if name=="benchmark_tools" or name.startswith("benchmark_tools.") or name=="orthohmm" or name.startswith("orthohmm."))
assert not modules
assert all(item["phase"]=="canary" for item in blocked)
print("QFO_COMPONENT_PROBE_JSON="+json.dumps({"status":"qfo_parameter_original_path_guard_passed","original_checkout":forbidden,"copied_driver":driver,"cwd":os.getcwd(),"python_isolated":sys.flags.isolated,"canary_rejected":True,"blocked_canary_events":blocked,"original_path_events_after_canary":0,"observed_file_events":observed["file_events"],"loaded_project_modules":modules,"output":output,"publication_ready":False,"limitations":["Python audit-event observation and denied canary, not OS-level containment or hermetic dependency restoration."]},sort_keys=True))
